summary: First-pass MVP testing of Ritual cross-venue loyalty platform. Backend pytest: 19/20 passed, 1 skipped (dependent). Frontend Playwright E2E: full critical path passes — admin login → /discover with 6 venues + Day/Night filters → venue detail → /checkin → confirm arrival (+100 pts) → feedback → /wallet (balance updated, ledger + Held in reserve shown) → /redeem picks Lumen + Complimentary Signature (500) → reservation code R-XXXXXXXX generated. Staff login lands on /staff (Lumen only), status button 'Filling In' updates venue and shows 'Room set to Filling In' toast. Regular member Alex is correctly redirected from /staff to /discover. Backend authorization checks (staff cross-venue 403, non-staff 403) all pass.

minor.issue: Tier gate check runs AFTER balance check. A Regular member trying `inner_experience` (1000 pts, Devotee-required) with insufficient balance gets 400 'Not enough Ritual Points' instead of the intended 403 'reserved for Devotee'. Request explicitly stated 'Backend should return 403 if bypassed'. Reorder: perform tier-gate check BEFORE balance check in /app/backend/server.py around line 476.

action_items: Reorder tier-gate vs balance check in POST /api/wallet/redeem so tier gate returns 403 before the 400 balance error (server.py ~line 476-486).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /wallet/redeem: tier check should precede balance check (see minor issue).
server.py: no rate limiting / brute force lockout on /api/auth/login — playbook mentions expected lockout after 5 fails. Not implemented. Consider adding if required by playbook.

server.py: seed_database() runs on every startup and overwrites venue status/capacity via `$set` of the full doc — a staff status update will be reset if backend restarts. Non-critical for demo but worth noting.
server.py seed_database preserves user ID on existing users (good) but always rewrites password_hash — this is correct for admin-password rotation via env.
server.py: JWT_SECRET, ADMIN_EMAIL, ADMIN_PASSWORD are read at import via os.environ[...] — will crash fast if missing (good). bcrypt hash format $2b$ confirmed via login test.

server.py: CORS 'allow_origins=["*"]' fallback combined with allow_credentials=True is invalid per browsers; current .env sets explicit origins so it works, but the default fallback in code would break if CORS_ORIGINS is unset.
Frontend axios `withCredentials: true` and httpOnly SameSite=None cookies verified working across preview domain.
seed_data_creation: None; used pre-seeded fixtures. Test created 1 event titled 'TEST_Event' at Lumen and 3 admin redemptions during E2E (admin balance dropped from 1240 to 940 across test runs — safe for demo).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs via `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. The tier-gate test asserts 403 which currently fails as 400 — main agent should fix ordering in wallet/redeem then this test will pass. Admin balance may be depleted across runs (was 940 after run); reseed by restarting won't reset balance since users are updated in-place. Frontend flows confirmed end-to-end on mobile viewport 390x844.
rca of the issue: Tier gate 400 vs 403: server.py /wallet/redeem checks `balance < perk.cost` (returns 400) before `user_tier_idx < perk_tier_idx` (returns 403). For low-balance Regular users this masks the tier violation. Fix: swap the two blocks so tier check runs first.
